title: Learner-model update output v1
description: Structured output of the LLM learner-model implementation for one (learner, skill) pair (ADR-0013). The harness asks for one skill at a time and records the output as a learner_skill.updated v1 payload: every field here is copied verbatim into the field of the same name, and the harness adds pack_id, skill_id, previous (from the projection) and provenance. Field schemas are taken from that payload by $ref so the two cannot drift. Harness-side checks the schema cannot express: evidence_ids must be a subset of the evidence ids given to the model in this call; an output that fails validation changes no state.

next.description: The new skill state. 'Correct final state is not mastery': hint_dependency, transfer_score and misconceptions carry the distinction between accidental success, hint-dependent success and systematic diagnosis, as reported by the evidence.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence this update rests on (at least one).

rationale.description: Why the state moved, citing the evidence.

predicted_success_probability.description: Probability that the learner succeeds at the next task on this skill (ADR-0011 calibration).
